relations: A slow ripple propagates across the pond, continuously warping the mirrored trunk and branches of the central leafless tree.
The undulating surface shifts reflected sky patches on the right, reshaping the mirror image while the actual tree remains fixed.
Foreground reeds, flanking hills, and distant peaks hold their positions as only their water reflections deform with the passing ripple.
caption: The video captures a wide, still landscape where a large leafless tree stands rooted at the center of a calm pond, its bare branches spreading upward, left, and right against a cloudless blue sky. Dry golden reeds line the foreground, while low brown hills rise on either side of the valley and faint snow-dusted peaks sit on the distant horizon. The water mirrors the tree and the sky, and across the clip a slow, subtle ripple moves across the surface. This gentle undulation continuously deforms the mirrored trunk and branches, shifting the reflected lines and reshaping the bright patches of sky on the right of the water. The tree, the reeds, the hills, and the sky appear to hold their positions, and the framing stays consistent without obvious pan, zoom, or tilt. No object enters or leaves the scene, and no contact or completion event occurs. The rippling reflection is the most evident motion, persisting quietly from beginning to end.
